_note: Static, citable sources used as baselines. Live, updatable sources (HN, OpenAlex) are recorded with fetch timestamps in data/signals/. Claims are list memberships or findings quoted from the documents; no numbers are invented. Wording and pages were checked against the official PDFs on 2026-10-23 (page = PDF page; 'pdf' links open at that page). 'MY' claims come from the Malaysia economy profile of the Future of Jobs Report 2025.

wef_skill_ai_bigdata.text: 'AI and big data' is the fastest-growing skill in employers' outlook to 2030.

wef_skill_cyber.text: 'Networks and cybersecurity' is the second fastest-growing skill.

wef_skill_techlit.text: 'Technological literacy' is the third fastest-growing skill.

wef_skill_creative.text: 'Creative thinking' is expected to keep rising in importance.

wef_skill_curiosity.text: 'Curiosity and lifelong learning' and 'Resilience, flexibility and agility' are expected to keep rising in importance.

wef_skill_leadership.text: 'Leadership and social influence' is among the top 10 skills on the rise.

wef_skill_analytical.text: 'Analytical thinking' remains the top core skill for employers: seven out of 10 companies consider it essential.

wef_skill_env.text: 'Environmental stewardship' is among the top 10 skills on the rise.
